description: Shared apply cases for every flow operation engine. Each case applies `operations` to `base` in order; it either yields `expected` and the normalized `forward_operations` (optional fields left unset are omitted; when absent they equal `operations`), or raises the named `error` with its `code` and leaves `base` unchanged. Keyed lists follow node_schema.json.

cases.name: empty operation list leaves the flow unchanged
add_nodes appends new nodes
add_nodes rejects an existing id
add_nodes rejects a duplicate id within the request
add_nodes rejects a node without an id
set_field replaces a template value
set_field creates a missing final object key
set_field writes an output selected by name
set_field replaces a whole position
set_field rejects an integer path segment
set_field rejects a missing intermediate key
set_field rejects changing the node id
set_field rejects replacing data.node.template whole
set_field rejects an unknown node
update_nodes rejects two updates to one path
delete_field removes an object key
delete_field of a missing key is a no-op
delete_field rejects an integer path segment
delete_nodes removes incident edges
delete_nodes rejects an unknown node
add_edges connects existing nodes
add_edges rejects a missing endpoint
add_edges rejects an existing id
add_edges after add_nodes in one batch
delete_edges ignores unknown and repeated ids
update_metadata sets and deletes top-level keys
update_metadata rejects graph collection keys
base flow with duplicate node ids is rejected
base flow with an edge missing its source is rejected
